blocks.Gervigreind les bókhaldið í Business Cen: AI reads the accounts in Business Central through Bifröst and builds interactive dashboards for the board, finance and operations, in Icelandic or English, with figures you can trace down to entries. Here is the whole process, with visual examples from the Vélsmiðjan group.

blocks.Miðstöðin og mælaborðin eru ein síða með: The hub and the dashboards are one page with subpages, so you move between them inside the app without a browser opening.
blocks.Föst sniðmát: sama útgáfa hjá öllum: Fixed templates: the same version for everyone
blocks.Gervigreindin skrifar ekki útlit mælabor: The AI does not write the dashboard layout. Each dashboard and the hub are fixed templates that Origo built from an approved version. The AI only fetches the data, and scripts in the plugin build the pages. So every user gets exactly the same layout, tabs, charts and functions, only with their own company's figures.

blocks.Þegar þú biður um breytingu eða nýjar tö: When you ask for a change or new figures in one dashboard, only that dashboard is updated, along with your additions to it. Other dashboards, the hub and Automation stay unchanged unless you ask otherwise.
blocks.Aðeins merktu skrárnar eru birtar aftur;: Only the marked files are republished; the others stay in the artifact as they were.
blocks.<b>Gögnin eru geymd með síðunum</b> (<co: The data is stored with the pages (data/*.json and manifest.json), so there is no need to fetch everything again to change one dashboard.
blocks.<b>Aðeins það sem mælaborðið þarf</b> er: Only what the dashboard needs is fetched from BC.
blocks.<b>Viðbætur þínar</b> (nýtt graf, tafla: Your additions (a new chart, table or card) are saved as ext/<mælaborð>.html and inserted automatically on every update.
blocks.<b>Miðstöðin</b> er aðeins uppfærð ef ly: The hub is only updated if the KPI on the dashboard's card changes.
blocks.<b>Í lokin</b> segir gervigreindin í ein: At the end the AI says in one line what was updated and that everything else is unchanged.
blocks.Víðara umfang aðeins ef þú segir það: „u: Wider scope only if you say so: “update all the dashboards”, “everything” or “set up again”.

blocks.Pakki af leiðbeiningum, og stundum skrif: A package of instructions, and sometimes scripts and templates, that teaches the AI one task, e.g. “how to build a board dashboard from BC”. Each skill has a short description; the AI reads the descriptions and loads only the skill that applies. Skills store no data.
blocks.Það sem gervigreindin hefur fyrir framan: What the AI has in front of it in the conversation: the messages, the skills that were loaded, results from Bifröst and files. It is limited and disappears when the conversation ends. What needs to last is stored elsewhere: the dashboards as pages, and memory in Bifröst.
blocks.Grunnskillið <code>bifrost-gogn</code> l: The base skill bifrost-gogn lets Business Central do the sums: revenue per customer, cost per account or supplier, cost and price per job, and account movements per month. Drill-down works as before: every item opens down to accounts and entries. For a company with more than 5,000 entries in the period, entries for the largest items (80% of the amount) are included and the rest show a total. Runs stay fast for large companies and the numbers match to the króna.
blocks.Skill pluginsins eru <b>aðeins</b> notuð: The plugin’s skills are used only for the Bifröst dashboards: when you ask for dashboards, set them up or change them. General questions about operations or Business Central, other reports, documents and artifacts are independent of the plugin, and it does not change your settings, memory, skills or files outside the dashboards.
